notes.title: DUELIST UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33198961/fe5fd3c727339c1efb3219d81e9aac45a4337766.png[/img]
Howdy folks... this one took some time to make, but it is pretty fun!
When you get 180s, as soon as you move to the endless wave, one of the six Duelists will try to beat you, the fight will last close to a second. If you react faster enough (and each duelist is a bit different) you get a badge and keep alive on the pit...
There were some other technical tweaks... More duelists can appear later... And I am very happy about how this tiny story is being told through gameplay and music.  Please check it! 
Many many thanks for the support and feedback! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2998040/BLOODSAINT/

notes.title: BLAM!!!BLAM!!!BLAM!!! UPDATE V. 0.06
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33198961/6c97d8195f50feddf8400712d243eb5adc366e25.png[/img]
Howdy folks! BLOODSAINT Update 0.06 is online, and it brings pretty nice stuff to this development journey! 
BLOODSAINT moved to 64-bit architecture, allowing more complex animations without breaking the PC requirements... now, when you shoot your fridge-sized plasma blast (that got boosted), the damage animation has more details, hard parts will fly, slip, and sink, and the soft meat will join different layers of the red pool. The extra layers, particles, and steps will not change much, but are kinda poetic. Game got balancing tweaks, performance tune, and I am testing new concepts for the late game (200+ seconds) aimed for the hardboilded veterans of this awesome community. Many many thanks!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2998040/BLOODSAINT/

notes.title: QUICKER UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33198961/00f1bfcdb5f64a7b66918e8921e58751780c7dc0.png[/img]

Steam Early Access is pretty magical. I have some buddies trying it here in Brazil, and the nicest folks are playing the same game thousands of kilometers away, with similar feedback guiding this update.

We have a new enemy class that moves with lightning speed and cirurgical precision, like a zoomed spider, a vampire in movies, a chess queen with long movements, or a mutted banshee with a flak cannon. To deal with it, you have your melee "sword breaker" with limited stamina, a full-auto Flak cannon, and the human factor, which finds gaps to solve stuff in your own way.

It moved from 2 to 5+1 enemy classes (from QQF1 to QQF2) to test your reflexes and combat awareness.

The texture maps and surfaces were polished to add performance, and the protagonist death animations were tweaked to look nicer.

The level generation was tuned following player feedback.

It is a nice time to SSS it!

Many thanks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2799110/QUICKERFLAK_2/

You may play Accro in the morning before work, and when you come back to fly during the night, new obstacles may be waiting for you.

Any doubt? Please ask on the hub, I will be glad to help! AccrO is a mix of science project and love letter.
Wanna share your impressions? Please use the hub, I am always open for ideas (it can take some time to enter on the project due to the sequence to make it work), and if you like what are you seeing, a Steam review is super fuelling and heart-warming!

Thank you a lot for the support!

notes.title: THE DARK MIX UPDATE
notes.notes:
It is not just about development, I play UBERMOSH Vol.7, for fun, a lot. Shredded it during Closed Alpha, Early Access, 1.0, 1.1...1.2.....and finally I came with the Dark Mix Update. The game was made following players' feedback, and some elements still surprise me, like the thugs A.I. and how awesome is it to test new ways to use the powers.
One lesson I learned developing TTV and TTV2 and it was inserted on all previous UBERMOSH: Randomic changes on how the light is pre-rendered on the floor refresh players' perception. TTVs change level filters each maze and the UBERMOSH games change a bit "light projection/ground tonality" each match. Now, it works on Vol.7 too.
While experimenting variations on the OST I brought back the Dark Mix, a "tweak" that I liked to make on the tracks to "listen while driving". Low tunning plus some degrees of a special reverb setup that can morph surf music thru the darkest metal. Now, on Vol.7, the dark-mixed can randomly play with the classic tracks, and I hope you have as much fun as I am having.
Many many thanks for the support and hub interactions, it is guiding the development and performance updates. If you like what you are seeing, please, please, make a review on Steam, it helps a lot to spread the seed.

Play it loud!
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/waltermachado

notes.title: Louder Update
notes.notes:
Howdy folks, I keep revisiting all the games I launched adding compatibility updates when needed, performance updates when possible and music every time I find a new beat that fits the game universe. UBERMOSH OST started with 7 tracks, has 15 now and it keeps expanding. Today I launched SWARMRIDER OMEGA OST, with the heavier and faster track versions of the classic SWARMRIDERS OST with 2 new tracks "Combustor" and "Trespass", Combustor goes following the lowtunned 180/360 bpm tracks of the OMEGA versions and Trespass aims for a microtonal texture experience. The classic SWARMRIDERS got the ULTAKAAR microtonal track a few time ago and the MORTALITY track can be found inside UBERMOSH OST folder since the Vol.5 launch. I am still working on more stuff and excited to show it as soon as possible.
Thousands of thanks for the support, Steam recommendations, Youtube videos, press reviews and hub feedback. It is hard to express how glad I am to have the luck of sharing this game experience with such nice audience.
Hope you like the new content. See you soon.

notes.title: LEGACY UPDATE
notes.notes:
Howdy folks, I keep revisiting and updating all stuff I launched over time. During the previous 2 weeks I made a "legacy update" doing some tweaks on the games to improve compatibility with the latest versions of Windows and brand new processors.
UBERMOSH Vol.3, UBERMOSH:WRAITH, Trip to Vinelands and SWARMRIDERS got updated. No compatibility issues were found on UBERMOSH, UBERMOSH:BLACK and UBERMOSH Vol.5.

UBERMOSH OST got a new free update. Yep, it started with seven tracks and with the new additions over the years fifteen tracks can be found inside the pack.

Owners of the "Collection pack" that bought the collection way before the launch of the latest volumes can find it updated with all the 5 volumes + updated OST

Progressive discounts were increased if you want to complete the Desktop Distortions or the Ultakaar Chronicles pack.

It is hard to say how much awesome is being riding with this awesome community, thank you, for all the support, feedback, reviews, videos and recommendations.

See you in the next update.

notes.title: 1.9 Performance Update
notes.notes:
Howdy folks, version 1.9 brings some performance updates reducing the processing weight of the particles effects. Less than 10% of the players got the tougher badges and I can not morph UBERMOSH more without transforming it to another product or increasing the minimum requirements.

Hope you like it!
See you soon, now on both hubs.

notes.title: UBERMOSH Update "Steam Cards"
notes.notes:
Howdy folks, it is very nice to compare the first UBERMOSH version on Steam early access (no terrain textures, less complex enemy AI and respawn system, no "red gun", no class mods, reduced SFX complexity, no ZQSD/Arrows support, no Xbox360 gamepad support, 1/3 of enemies sprites, 1/3 soundtrack, no Hardboiled mode, no 16:9 screen support, less ranks, less player skins, no miniHUD, reduced weapon balance, no Steam Achievements...) and the actual version.
Your feedback and support is the key to all game changes and soon we will be able call the 1.0 version of UBERMOSH.

I like the idea of cards as a fan-service, so I created some Ultakaar desert landscape views, like an expanded universe, and inspired on MTG mana cards, please check it.

Thanks guys, time to return working on the game.

If you like the way the game is being shaped, please recommend it.

Walter Machado

notes.title: UBERMOSH Update "chaos and balance"
notes.notes:
Howdy folks, UBERMOSH development would be impossible without community feedback. Not all ideas can go straight to the project but I read every suggestion. This update balances version 0.011 giving more bullet speed and accuracy to the single shot gun to level it with the yellow and gray gun. Now you will find two kinds of enemies carrying the red gun and they will behave a bit more strategically, forcing you to survive a bit longer to put your hands on that chaos bringer. Gamepad users will also be able to use shoulders and triggers (and not just triggers). Enemy AI got a little update to mimetize more the human behaviour (evading, flanking, running and regrouping).

Time to return to work.
Thank you all for the support, reviews, youtube videos and feedback.

If you like the way the game is being shaped, please recommend it.

Walter Machado

notes.title: UBERMOSH Update v0.009 Hardboiled
notes.notes:
Howdy folks, a few things have been changed to create a fair experience for the varios kinds of players that may cut bullets on the pit. On the "classic mode" you will have the 3-act style gameplay, starting with your sword hunting the first thug and getting a gun. Survive the crescent number of enemies until you find the red gun and use the gun advantage to bring hell to your foes. The improvement is that now enemies will not respawn without a fair distance for your reaction. Also some cosmetic features have been inserted on the game.
For those who want more trouble, check on "extras" the HARDBOILED mode. A raging turba will find you since the first seconds of game. The new balancing will make you react faster changing the pace from the classic mode to an even more hardcore experience.

Thank you guys for your support and feedback
If you like the shape the game is taking, please recommend it.

Walter Machado

notes.title: UBERMOSH Update
notes.notes:
Howdy folks,
Our first month on Steam Early Access and we walked from version 0001 to version 0008. I am taking of care of the art, code and music while you provide awesome feedback. Terrain textures inserted, ZQSD and Arrows support, new weapon, miniboss update, enemy respawn rebalanced, enemy AI rebalanced, mini HUD, new music tracks inserted and now I have fixed the tearing that appeared on some monitors.
Some of your suggestions are still being tested and may appear on the next updates. Some ideas sound nice but do not fit the game objective which is giving you intense 90 seconds of gameplay, with no fillers or farming. An arcade experience to fit your daily routine without consuming much time.

And now?
Let´s do another awesome development month.

Thank you all guys.
If you like the way it is being shaped, please recommend it.

More stuff soon

Walter Machado

notes.title: UBERMOSH Update v0.008
notes.notes:
Howdy folks,
it's been a busy week, the thugs AI got a tweak, respawns have been rebalanced, HUD inserted, previous score reference added on the top right corner and a few other changes designed to give you at least 3 combat postures during each procedural level. You will start hunting the first thug to get a gun. Manage the risk to find the "braniac" enemy as soon as possible and get his gun without being overwhelmed. With the gun advantage, beat enemies like rats aiming for a high score and get the SSS+ rank. All in 90 seconds. You can also keep stationary, cutting bullets, reflecting enemies destructive power, mix strategies or find your personal combat style.
The soundtrack DLC people asked on the Hub is now available, with some tracks that will appear only on the latest builds of UBERMOSH.

Hope you like the extra content. Now I will return to work to prepare the next update.

Thanks for the reviews, feedbacks, youtube videos and articles.
If you like the shape the game is taking, please recommend it.

New content soon

Walter Machado

there will be lots of bullets on your screen because UBERMOSH is now 30% more hardcore.
